description:
Recently refurbished semi-detached property in a quiet cul-de-sac. This home features a modern fitted kitchen with some integrated appliances, a spacious living room, two double bedrooms, and a stylish bathroom. The property also offers a generously sized lawned garden to the rear, providing a perfect space for outdoor activities. There is parking available, and potential for extension, subject to planning permission. Situated within catchment areas for several highly regarded nurseries, primary and secondary schools, this home is ideal for families. Conveniently located with easy access to the city centre, a regular bus service, and nearby motorway links (M6 & A69 at Junction 43). Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to local clubs including squash, rugby, football, and golf. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity - contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Directions From Carlisle city centre, head East on Warwick Road towards the M6. Turn right onto Victoria Road and proceed over the brow of the hill past the shops. Turn left onto Broadoaks Grange, the property is situated within the last cul-de-sac on the right-hand side and can be identified by number on the front elevation.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
